newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures finish mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures finish mostly lower.

text.p: Sept 17 - IMM currencies ended mostly down in quiet trade, pressured by a strong dollar amid perceptions a U.S. rate hike was at hand and from dollar-bullish comments from Mickey Kantor. Overall action was light, with traders awaiting July trade data on Wednesday. Forecasts were for the U.S. trade gap to widen to $8.8 bln from $8.1 bln in June. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
